meta.name: experiment-readout
meta.description: 假设 + 指标 + 结果 + 解释 + 决策, 把 A/B 或产品实验转成行动建议

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把实验数据转化为可执行的行动建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常分析产品实验并需要清晰的下一步行动
copy.tagline_en: Turn experiment data into actionable recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze product experiments and need clear next steps

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 A/B 测试或产品实验的数据整理成一份决策报告，包含假设、指标、结果、解释和下一步行动建议，而不是只展示数据。
howto.when: 当你提供 A/B 测试、增长实验、定价实验等实验数据（如 markdown、CSV 或表格），并要求复盘时触发。

say.text: 帮我复盘这个 A/B 测试，给出上线还是停止的建议。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含决策标签的实验报告。

say.text: 分析这个 onboarding 改版实验，告诉我下一步该怎么做。
say.note: Claude 会输出假设、结果和后续实验建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude transforms A/B test or product experiment data into a decision report including hypothesis, metrics, results, interpretation, and next steps, rather than just displaying data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide experiment data (e.g., markdown, CSV, or table) from A/B tests, growth experiments, pricing experiments, etc., and ask for a readout.

say_en.text: Review this A/B test and recommend whether to ship or stop.
say_en.note: Claude generates a report with a decision badge.

say_en.text: Analyze this onboarding experiment and tell me what to do next.
say_en.note: Claude outputs hypothesis, results, and follow-up experiments.
